# Developers Matrix

> Free browser tools for PC gaming (Can You Run It, FPS Calculator, Bottleneck Calculator), website audits and SEO, and job hunting, plus guides and trend reports. No signup.

---

## Brand Entity

Official Brand Name: Developers Matrix (two words)
Also Written As: DevelopersMatrix
Official Domain: https://developersmatrix.com
Primary Language: English
Content Type: Educational, AI Tools, SEO, Productivity, Career Resources, Technology Insights

---

## About

Developers Matrix is a platform focused on AI-powered tools, technical SEO resources, productivity systems, career optimization, and technology education.

The platform provides practical tools, educational content, market insights, and interactive utilities designed for:
- Developers
- Entrepreneurs
- Job seekers
- Marketers
- Students
- Tech professionals

Our goal is to help users improve productivity, career growth, digital presence, and decision-making through actionable tools and high-quality educational resources.

## Main Sections

### PC Gaming Tools

- [Can You Run It](https://developersmatrix.com/tools/can-you-run-it): compares a PC with the minimum and recommended specs each publisher released, and gives a compatibility score with an estimated frame rate. Every game page links to its official source.
- [FPS Calculator](https://developersmatrix.com/tools/fps-calculator): estimates average frame rate and 1% low at 1080p, 1440p and 4K for a processor and graphics card, from Tom's Hardware benchmark results, with separate figures for 10 popular games.
- [Bottleneck Calculator](https://developersmatrix.com/tools/bottleneck-calculator): shows whether a processor holds back a graphics card at each resolution.
- [GTA 6 PC requirements](https://developersmatrix.com/tools/can-you-run-it/gta-6): GTA 6 has no PC version yet; this page shows what Rockstar asks for in its current PC games.
- [GTA 6 launch guide](https://developersmatrix.com/gta-6): release times, reviews, console performance and PC status.

### SEO and Website Tools

- [Website Audit Tool](https://developersmatrix.com/tools/website-audit): over 70 named checks across SEO, technical, performance, security, content, accessibility and mobile, with a prioritized fix list.
- [AI Crawler Checker](https://developersmatrix.com/tools/ai-crawler-checker): reads a site's robots.txt for each AI crawler (OAI-SearchBot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and others) and shows the exact rule that allows or blocks it.
- [AI Content Detector](https://developersmatrix.com/tools/ai-content-detector)

### Career and Productivity Tools

- [AI Resume Builder](https://developersmatrix.com/tools/ai-resume-builder)

## Editorial Standards

Content is reviewed and updated regularly for:
- Accuracy
- Relevance

Content creation focuses on:
- Originality

Low-quality, misleading, or deceptive content is not intentionally published.
